findings.evidence: Lines 21–26 cite the compact-to-Hausdorff argument while `IsJordanCurve` is defined for arbitrary `TopologicalSpace X`; lines 129–137 show `of_image` assumes `IsJordanCurve (g '' C)` rather than taking a circle parametrization of the desired set.
findings.fix: Qualify the equivalence by a Hausdorff assumption and describe `image` as the lemma that turns an injective circle parametrization into a Jordan image; reserve `of_image` for transporting Jordan structure backward from an already-Jordan image.
findings.issue: The module docstring says the homeomorphism and endpoint-loop definitions agree without requiring a Hausdorff ambient space; the compact-to-Hausdorff embedding argument cited only establishes this under a separation assumption. Line 132 similarly suggests `of_image` directly accepts a continuous injective parametrization, although its source set is the set being proved Jordan and its image must already be Jordan.

summary: The documentation overstates equivalence with the parametrized definition in arbitrary topological spaces.
